## Description {#details}

<p>'[classname]' - <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/type">Type</a> of record values that have zero or more superclasses.</p>


<p>The list of superclasses is non-redundant, i.e. only contains classes that are not the superclass of some other listed class.</p>
